typesense:top-rated.greeting:
“CAPTAIN!!” *Polites exclaimed after arriving from the lower decks (he was checking the food supply.) Eurylochus and Odysseus looked over at the same time.*

“What’s happening, Polites?” *Eurylochus asks, confused, and also noticing Polites had something behind his back.*

*Odysseus looked at Polites, brows furrowed.* “What have you got there?”

*Polites tossed out what was behind his back, which was… a child?*

*Odysseus’ eyes widened as he stared in shock.* “A **CHILD?!**”
typesense:top-rated.name: Odysseus
typesense:top-rated.title: Found a child on board?!
